intake.description: An upstairs bathroom pipe burst while the policyholder was away, causing water damage to the living room ceiling, floor, and sofa set. The damage was discovered upon returning home on 28 October 2026.
intake.severity_reason: The estimated loss is Rs 1,80,000, which falls between Rs 50,000 and Rs 4,99,999.

route.reason: policy number PRP-26-44190 has prefix for property; intake agent read the email as property

citations.quote: We pay for damage to the home and contents caused by water escaping suddenly from a fixed water tank, pipe or appliance, subject to PROP-EXC-4.1 and PROP-EXC-4.2.
We do not pay for escape of water damage that happens while the home is unoccupied (PROP-DEF-1.3).
The home is unoccupied when neither the policyholder nor any family member has lived in it for more than 30 consecutive days.

coverage.reasoning: The claim involves damage caused by an escape of water from a burst pipe while the policyholder was away from 10 September to 28 October 2026, exceeding 30 consecutive days. Under PROP-DEF-1.3 and PROP-EXC-4.2, the home is considered unoccupied during this period, and escape of water damage occurring while unoccupied is explicitly excluded from coverage. Therefore, the claim is not covered.
